name: @pipeworx/mcp-spacex

tools.name: get_latest_launch
tools.description: Get the most recent SpaceX launch. Returns launch name, date (UTC), success status, mission details, rocket, launch pad, and media links (webcast, article, wikipedia).

tools.name: get_next_launch
tools.description: Get the next upcoming SpaceX launch. Returns launch name, scheduled date (UTC, may be TBD), mission details, rocket, and launch pad.

tools.name: get_past_launches
tools.description: Get recent past SpaceX launches sorted by date descending. Returns name, date (UTC), status, and success for each launch.

limit.description: Number of launches to return (default 10, max 100)

tools.name: get_rockets
tools.description: List SpaceX rocket configurations (Falcon 1, Falcon 9, Falcon Heavy, Starship, …). Returns name, family, reusability, maiden flight, launch cost, launch/success counts, and success rate.

tools.name: get_crew
tools.description: List astronauts who have flown (or are assigned to) SpaceX Crew Dragon missions. Returns name, agency, in-flight status, mission, role, wikipedia, and image URL. Derived from recent crewed SpaceX launches.

limit.description: Max crew members to return (default 20, max 50)

tools.name: get_starlink
tools.description: Get live Starlink satellites from the public catalog (CelesTrak), sorted by most recent orbital-element epoch. Returns object name, NORAD/COSPAR id, epoch, mean motion, inclination, and eccentricity.

limit.description: Number of satellites to return (default 20, max 200)

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-spacex forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the spacex pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
